verdict.rationale: Internal comment side-threads with @mentions are a fair axis for an email product, but the evidence pack never documents comments or @mentions beside a message in Gmail. Delegation (shared account access) and Workspace add-ons (a developer framework for custom UIs) are an adjacent control and a building block, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a team-lead, we can discuss an email in an internal side-thread — comments and @mentions beside the message — instead of forwarding copies around
